bibl.title: Power, Life, and Death in the House of Ptolemy: The Years 145-143 BC.
bibl.seg: Eddy Lanciers, Power, Life, and Death in the House of Ptolemy: The Years 145-143 BC.
bibl.note: The return of Ptolemy VIII to Egypt and the beginning of his second reign. - The birth of Ptolemy Memphites and the Egyptian coronation of Ptolemy VIII. - The death of the youngest son of Ptolemy VI and Cleopatra II and the marriage of Ptolemy VIII and Cleopatra II. - Conclusion.
